findings.title: §4's Entry/Fields emitter cannot emit R4's record. `buildEnvelope` rejects the AD13 `error` object because `snapshot_unavailable` is absent from `runtimeErrorInfo` (`internal/observe/envelope.go:103-130,144-165`), so `Logger.Log` writes `logging_write_failed` (`internal/observe/log.go:85-95`). `NewEnvelope` (`envelope.go:78`) cannot carry `Fields`, so the "direct envelope build" cannot carry `failure_reason`/`quarantine_path`. AC2-2 and AC1-5b are unsatisfiable under T2's exhaustive envelope edit set. Fix: enumerate a `runtimeErrorInfo` case (resource/true/static remediation) or an `ErrorInfo`+validated-`Fields` emitter, and pin it in T2/AC1-5b.
findings.fix: enumerate a `runtimeErrorInfo` case (resource/true/static remediation) or an `ErrorInfo`+validated-`Fields` emitter, and pin it in T2/AC1-5b.

findings.title: `quarantine_path` is missing from `envelopeFieldNames` (`envelope.go:556-706`) and the docs `envelope-fields` union (`docs/logging-contract.md:102-190`). `TestLoggingContractDocumentsExactEnvelopeFieldUnion` (`cmd/mcp-bridge/logging_contract_test.go:114`) compares them exactly, so adding the field to the authoritative union fails the suite; a prose-only sentence leaves the union incomplete, and `checkClosedFieldPaths` rejects the emitted field. T2 says "(c) nothing else changes" and lists only three doc additions. Fix: enumerate the registry insertion and the union-list edit.
findings.fix: enumerate the registry insertion and the union-list edit.

findings.title: Ticket AC2-6 states "no `internal_error` wedge is emitted"; spec AC2-6 and R8 require at least one `startup_failed`/`internal_error` record. The ticket mirror also drops AC1-5b(b), AC2-7 byte assertions and AC2-8(b)'s "no quarantine file, empty result". Non-blocking class, but the engineering acceptance text is wrong.

T2 routes `ErrSnapshotUnrecoverable`→`stateDirectoryFailure`, but `startupFailureForError(err)` takes no path (`cmd/mcp-bridge/startup_failure.go:108-112`) while `stateDirectoryFailure` requires one (`:26-33`); §4 also says serve returns `stateDirectoryFailure(store.Dir())`. Risk: a pathless `state_directory` record failing AC2-4's `resource.path`. Fix: specify exactly one route.
`RetentionFailure *RetentionFailure` (singular) cannot report one record per affected family as R5 requires; no AC covers both families' prune failing. Fix: slice result plus an AC.
R1's "never in Reload, mid-run saves, or `ensureReplaceable`" has no oracle (R1 maps only to AC2-1). Add a negative reload/save transition test.
R7 "identical quarantine behavior" is covered only for rename/bytes (AC1-4). There is no prompts retention-bound, prompts warning-record, or prompts `read_error` oracle.

Prune ranks the just-created quarantine file; a backward clock or equal timestamp can sort it oldest and delete it, contradicting R2 "bytes are preserved exactly". Fix: never prune the file created in this recovery.
findings.fix: never prune the file created in this recovery.

findings.title: `snapshot_retention_failed` has no `eventMessage` case (`internal/observe/log.go:227-276`; default `:275`), so it emits `"mcp-bridge event"` while the AD13 row promises a fixed message. `log.go` is outside T2's write paths and AC1-5b does not assert message.
AC1-2's `read_error` row asserts only the reason, not rename/bytes preservation (R2) [r-ac-coverage-gap].
A post-rename sync fatal skips retention, so R5's "at most 5" is not guaranteed on that path [lifecycle-hazard].
§6.1 read paths omit `cmd/mcp-bridge/logging_contract_test.go`, which pins the envelope union [ledger-state-drift].
AC1-5b's "record emitter" is undefined; the design emits inline in `serve.go` [undefined-term].
"strict RFC3339Nano UTC" is not pinned to `Z`; `time.Parse` accepts `+02:00` family names, which may then be counted/pruned [r-ac-coverage-gap].
